families.mechanism: class S: Exploration memory: the policy keeps returning to receptacles whose contents it has already seen; support = removing already-inspected, tomato-free receptacles from the navigation choices while no tomato is in hand.
families.name: explored_receptacle_pruning
families.why: All 10 failures open the fridge first, then walk the 23 cabinets and the drawers (re-visiting the fridge 5-15 times); 9 of 10 never visit diningtable 1, the only surface holding a tomato; the one rollout that reaches it (F6, step 45) takes the tomato and runs out of steps.

families.mechanism: class G: Goal decomposition: the policy does not map the goal wording to the object type it must pick up and the transformation it must apply; support = spelling the goal as its sub-steps in the observation.
families.name: goal_decomposition_annotation
families.why: All 10 failures open cabinets 1-26 and the drawers for 50 steps; every rollout visits countertop 1 and SEES 'a plate 1' among 11 objects there (step ~28) and never takes it; no rollout heats anything; 'hot plate' is never decomposed into plate -> heat -> place.

families.mechanism: class P: The policy treats 'use desklamp' as the completing action regardless of what it holds; support = rejecting that action while no cellphone is in hand, with the goal precondition as the reason.
families.name: precondition_gating
families.why: All 10 failures go to desk 1 at step 1, 'use desklamp 1' at step 2 (the lamp is there, the cellphone is not), then alternate look / examine desk 1 / use desklamp 1 for the remaining 48 steps; at most one drawer is ever opened; no rollout holds a cellphone.

families.mechanism: class P: The policy skips the required state change ('clean'); support = rejecting the placing action while the held potato has not been cleaned, with the missing step as the reason.
families.name: precondition_gating
families.why: All 10 failures take potato 1 from the fridge by step 4 and move it to the garbagecan by step 6 without cleaning it; 9 of 10 then loop take / move / inventory / examine garbagecan for ~45 steps; 2 rollouts pass the sinkbasin without using it; no rollout issues 'clean potato'.
